history.title: History
history.body:
The Diocese of Catarman was created by Pope Paul VI on December 5, 1974, and formally inaugurated on March 11, 1975, with the installation of Most Rev. Angel T. Hobayan as its first residential bishop. Its cathedral and seat is the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Annunciation in Catarman, the capital of Northern Samar.

The local Church covers the entire civil province of Northern Samar—bounded by the San Bernardino Strait, the Philippine Sea, the Samar Sea, and the neighboring Samar provinces. The faith in this land reaches back to the Jesuit mission in Palapag among the Ibabao people at the turn of the seventeenth century, later continued by the Franciscans. From those early missions grew the parishes that today form the diocese.

First a suffragan of Cebu, Catarman became a suffragan of the Archdiocese of Palo in 1982. Bishop Hobayan shepherded the young diocese until 2005. He was succeeded by Most Rev. Emmanuel C. Trance, who served until 2023. Most Rev. Nolly C. Buco, appointed by Pope Francis, was installed as the third Bishop of Catarman on January 15, 2025.

On March 11, 2025, the diocese marked its Golden Jubilee—fifty years of walking with the people of Northern Samar. Organized into four vicariates, the local Church continues to form disciples through its parishes, mission centers, and Basic Ecclesial Communities.

mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.body:
Vision
A synodal and mission-driven local Church in Northern Samar—masiningbahon, masinaksihon, masinerbihon—journeying together in communion, participation, and mission.

Mission
The Diocese of Catarman exists to proclaim Jesus Christ and form missionary disciples in every parish and barangay. We listen to God and to one another, strengthen Basic Ecclesial Communities as a way of life, accompany families and the youth, and serve especially the poor and those at the peripheries.

Pastoral Direction
Guided by the spirit of synodality, the diocese walks the path of shared discernment and responsible participation, so that every community may become a living witness of the Gospel in Northern Samar.

youthDirectorMessage.title: Youth Director's Message
youthDirectorMessage.subtitle: Fr. Godfrex U. Dublin
youthDirectorMessage.body:
Dear young people,

I just want to remind you of the words of our Holy Father (Leo XVI) that, "the Church trusts you and counting in you. Be witness of love, justice, and peace. Do not sacrifice your precious youth on the altar of artificial pleasures and superficiality.

Our deepest questions are not and will not be answered by endlessly scrolling our cellphones rather it just leaves us with tired minds and empty hearts.
The fulfillment of our authentic desires always comes through going beyond ourselves."

My prayers,

assistantYouthDirectorMessage.title: Asst. Youth Director's Message
assistantYouthDirectorMessage.subtitle: Fr. Edmund Irinco Corocoto
assistantYouthDirectorMessage.body:
An aton tema nga nasugad, "take courage, I have overcome the world", nag susumat sa aton sin kamatooran nga diri la naton kinahanglan nga mahibaroan kun diri labaw san ngatanan kinahanglan nga aton buhaton. Iton courage, 'kadasig' or 'kaisog' sa kasing-kasing, mao ini an nag tutulang sa aton agud aton buhaton an kamatooran ngan an kaupayan apisar san magkadurudilain nga ayat or kahimtang.

Sa luyo nga bahin, kon waray ini sa aton kasing-kasing, diri la kay makuri para sa aton an pag buhat san kamatooran ngan kaupayan, kundi impossible gud s aton. Sa panahon nga an aton nasud nanginginahanglan sin kusog agud mahi'undong an kamatooran ngan an kaupayan, mag ampo kita nga makarawat naton an grasya san kadasig o kaisog sa kasing-kasing agud matuman naton an aton misyon nga magin tinubdan ngan aragihan kita san kaupayan ngan kamatooran.

diocesanYouthCoordinatorMessage.title: Diocesan Youth Coordinator's Message
diocesanYouthCoordinatorMessage.subtitle: Mr. Claude Kit Amores
diocesanYouthCoordinatorMessage.body:
Take courage, young witnesses of Christ! The Diocesan Youth Day 2026 is calling us together on October 17–18, 2026 at San Isidro Central Elementary School, hosted by the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus Parish. With the theme "Take Courage! I Have Overcome the World" (John 16:33), we gather not just as delegates, but as one family of faith, united in courage, joy, and mission.

Mga kabataan, huwag kayong matakot — sapagkat si Kristo ang ating lakas at tagumpay. Ayaw kamo kahadlok, kay an aton Ginoo nagdaug na san kalibutan! This celebration is more than an event; it is a pilgrimage of hope, a festival of faith, and a testimony that the youth of Catarman are alive in Christ.

Expect moments of prayer, fellowship, testimonies, pilgrim walks, and Eucharistic celebrations that will ignite our spirits. Together, let us showcase our talents, deepen our faith, and strengthen our unity. As one diocese, we proclaim: Kabataan, magburublig kita! We are witnesses of His love, courage, and victory.

See you there, and let us make DYD 2026 a living witness of Christ's promise — that in Him, we have already overcome.

diocesanYouthLeaderMessage.title: Diocesan Youth Leader's Message
diocesanYouthLeaderMessage.subtitle: Jessa Mae S. Arcipe
diocesanYouthLeaderMessage.body:
My dear young people in Christ,

Greetings of joy and hope!

As we prepare for the Diocesan Youth Day 2026, my heart is filled with gratitude and excitement to journey with all of you once again.

DYD is not just an event, it is a homecoming. It is where we, the youth of the Diocese of Catarman, gather as one family to listen, to pray, and to rekindle the fire of our faith.

In a world full of noise and distractions, God is calling us to pause, to return to His Sacred Heart, and to rediscover our mission as young disciples. May this DYD be an opportunity for each one of us to say, "Yes, Lord, I am here."

I invite everyone - from our parishes, mission centers and youth ministries - to come with open hearts. Bring your stories, your joys, and even your struggles. Let us celebrate our being young, being Catholic, and being called to serve.

See you at DYD 2026!

Let us make this celebration a true encounter with Christ and with one another.

With love for the youth ministry,
